description: [capability-version: 0.9.98] The debug-only Tauri MCP automation bridge (tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge). It lives OUTSIDE capabilities/ so tauri-build never compiles it into the static ACL: attach_automation_bridge in src-tauri/src/app_plugins.rs adds it at runtime (Manager::add_capability) only in a debug build whose bridge actually started, so a release build grants no mcp-bridge permission at all. Every platform carries the plugin again since 0.13.1, the first release built on the webview2-com 0.39 / windows 0.62 that tauri 2.12 uses (see its entry in Cargo.toml).
